chapter: Family lore, Boston and Europe with Sam Price
title: Benny Morton and Claude Jones in Henderson's band
summary: Henderson had Jones and Morton; he let Jones go and JCH and Morton worked together.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: I also saw a picture of you and Benny Morton sitting together.
Yes. Was he in the Fletcher Henderson band when you were with Fletcher at all?
Not long. No, let's see, what happened? Whose place did I take?... Claude Jones? I dont remember.
But Benny Morton wasn't in the band at that time?
No, we didn't work in the band together. Let me see, who worked in the band? Claude Jones started.
Yes, but Benny Morton had played with Fletcher Henderson
also and I was just wondering if they were playing with Fletcher Henderson at the same time or at different times?
He had two trombones. He had Claude Jones and Benny Morton... He let Claude go and Benny and I worked together.
